title: The Hangouts
description: After those first few meetings, we started finding our own rhythm in the city. Every movie, every lunch, and every dinner felt like a small victory. I remember that constant, lingering fear—the way we’d get scared if we saw someone who looked even remotely familiar. We’d pull apart quickly, laughing nervously, our hearts racing for more than just one reason. But honestly? That fear only made the happiness more intense. Whether we were sitting in the back row of a dark theater or finding a quiet corner in a restaurant where we could actually be ourselves, those were the moments we really grew up together. We weren't just 'meeting' anymore; we were building a life in the gaps between the rest of the world’s gaze. Those stolen hours were ours, and I wouldn’t trade that nervous excitement for anything.
